decisions.reason: Adding 5V current measurement does not change the standalone 3.3V regulator, its activation condition, or its powered load.
The source adds monitoring of the existing 5V rail but does not change its voltage, loads, GPIO switching, or shutdown behavior.
Measuring the 5V rail does not change the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path topology.
The LEDs are mentioned only as major 5V consumers; their 5V supply and level-shifter requirements remain unchanged.
The rail-monitoring change does not affect the battery connector series, pinout, pitch, or mounting type.
The source does not change any interboard connector, pinout, or pin-order requirement.
The added 5V current measurement has no effect on the BOOT or reset circuit requirements.
The source does not alter the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
Adding 5V rail metering does not change USB enumeration or the USB-C programming interface.
The LEDs are cited as current consumers, but their cutoff behavior, control GPIO, and standby-current target are unchanged.
A possible second INA219 address does not itself change the established I2C pull-up, speed, cable, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The current-monitoring change does not affect battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
